notes.title: It's Patchday.
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Thanks for downloading and playing our game. It's super awesome to see that it is played and people care enough to leave us their comments. It's quite more than we had hoped for.

Here's a patch and it comes with a couple of UX improvements.
This is apparently not a UX improvement:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31787445/694f9354fecd5f528ec5f150dc63503094a8a2e3.jpg[/img]

Anyway. This is what the patch contains:
[list]
    [*]Fixed Tree in the Stars - we had that very special development version slip into the production build. Very professional. Much wow.
    [*]Fixed Black & White holes being hard to click on
    [*]Fixed 4-digit resource specs being truncated in the planet UI
    [*]Fixed mouse clicks going through the exit and success menus possibly causing unwanted planet-unlinks and a hellofalot confusion.
    [*]Fixed UI rendering on back & white holes
[/list]

That's all the UX hiccups we knew about and of course the last level, being fixed. 
Thanks again for playing!

Cheers,
-df
